products.title: Marigold Tiered Midi Dress
products.subtitle: Hand-embroidered cotton silk
products.description: A three-tiered midi cut from soft cotton silk, with a scattering of hand-worked marigold motifs across the bodice. The tiers are gathered by hand so the fall stays generous without adding weight. Fastens with a concealed side zip.
products.productCare: Iron on reverse at low heat. Store folded, away from direct light.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'8" and wears a size Small.

products.title: Amaira Halterneck Column Dress
products.subtitle: Washed linen
products.description: A long column dress in washed linen with a halter neckline and an open back. Cut close through the body and released below the knee. The neckline ties, so the fit can be adjusted through the shoulder.
products.productCare: Cool iron. Hang on a padded hanger to keep the shoulder line.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'9" and wears a size Small.

products.title: Sonal Cutwork Slip Dress
products.subtitle: Hand-cut appliqué
products.description: A bias-cut slip with hand-cut appliqué worked along the hem and straps. The bias gives the dress its movement; the cutwork is finished by hand on both faces so there is no wrong side.
products.productCare: Do not wring. Iron through a cloth.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'7" and wears a size Extra Small.

products.title: Nayantara Draped Wrap Dress
products.subtitle: Silk georgette
products.description: A true wrap in silk georgette, drawn across the front and tied at the waist. The drape is cut on the cross so it settles rather than bunches. Lined through the body.
products.productCare: Steam rather than press. Store on a hanger.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'8" and wears a size Medium.

products.title: Rukmini Chikankari Kurta Set
products.subtitle: Hand-embroidered mulmul
products.description: A straight kurta in fine mulmul, hand-embroidered in the chikankari tradition across the yoke and cuffs. Comes with straight-cut trousers in matching cloth. Roughly forty hours of hand work in each set.
products.productCare: Iron on reverse while slightly damp. Do not starch the embroidery.
products.washcare: Gentle hand wash separately, or dry clean
products.modelNote: Model is 5'8" and wears a size Small on top and Small below.

products.title: Bela Pintuck Kurta Set
products.subtitle: Pintucked cotton
products.description: Rows of fine pintucks run the length of this kurta, each pressed and stitched by hand. Paired with tapered trousers. The pintucking gives the panel its structure without any interlining.
products.productCare: Press the pintucks from the reverse to keep them sharp.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'9" and wears a size Medium on top and Small below.

products.title: Anjum Block-Print Kurta Set
products.subtitle: Hand block-printed
products.description: Block-printed by hand in a small workshop, so the register shifts a little from panel to panel. We consider that the point. A relaxed kurta with side slits and a wide-legged trouser.
products.productCare: Colours will soften with wear. Dry in shade.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'7" and wears a size Small on top and Medium below.

products.title: Kesar Waistcoat & Trouser Set
products.subtitle: Structured linen
products.description: A long waistcoat with a deep V and covered buttons, cut to fall past the hip, worn over a high-waisted straight trouser. Sized independently top and bottom because very few people are one size throughout.
products.productCare: Press on low heat through a cloth. Hang the waistcoat.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'9" and wears a size Small on top and Small below.

products.title: Palash Cropped Shirt & Palazzo Set
products.subtitle: Silk cotton
products.description: A cropped shirt with a soft collar and a dropped shoulder, worn with full palazzo trousers. Cut for movement and for heat. The trouser waist is part-elasticated at the back.
products.productCare: Cool iron. Do not tumble dry.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'8" and wears a size Medium on top and Medium below.

products.title: Neroli Knot-Front Co-ord
products.subtitle: Handloom cotton
products.description: A knot-front top in handloom cotton over a straight ankle-length skirt. The knot is functional, not decorative, and adjusts the fit across the bust.
products.productCare: Iron while damp. The weave will soften with each wash.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'6" and wears a size Small on top and Small below.

products.title: Chameli Tiered Skirt Set
products.subtitle: Organza and cotton
products.description: A tiered skirt in layered organza over a cotton underskirt, with a fitted bodice. The tiers are cut in graduating widths so the volume builds toward the hem.
products.productCare: Steam only. Store hanging, with space around it.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'9" and wears a size Small on top and Small below.

products.title: Gulmohar Panelled Skirt Set
products.subtitle: Panelled crepe
products.description: Eight panels give this skirt its swing. Worn with a cropped, structured top. The panels are seamed and topstitched so the shape holds through the day.
products.productCare: Press seams flat from the reverse.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'7" and wears a size Medium on top and Medium below.

products.title: Tarkashi Quilted Jacket
products.subtitle: Hand-quilted cotton
products.description: A collarless jacket, hand-quilted in fine running stitch across the whole body. Warm without bulk. Sits at the hip and fastens with a single hook at the throat.
products.productCare: Do not press the quilting flat. Air rather than clean where possible.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'8" and wears a size Small.

products.title: Saanjh Embroidered Overlay
products.subtitle: Sheer embroidered tulle
products.description: A floor-length open overlay in embroidered tulle, worked with a low, scattered motif that gathers toward the hem. Designed to be layered over almost anything.
products.productCare: Steam at a distance. Never press directly on the embroidery.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'10" and wears a size Medium.

products.title: Rangoli Organza Saree
products.subtitle: Hand-painted organza
products.description: Six and a half yards of organza, hand-painted in a loose floral repeat and finished with a narrow hand-rolled hem. Comes with an unstitched blouse piece.
products.productCare: Store rolled rather than folded to avoid creasing the paint.
products.modelNote: Draped on a 5'8" model.

products.title: Meher Handwoven Linen Saree
products.subtitle: Handwoven on pit looms
products.description: Woven on pit looms in fine linen with a contrast selvedge. Slubs and small irregularities in the weave are inherent to the cloth. Includes an unstitched blouse piece.
products.productCare: Improves with age. Iron while damp for a crisper drape.
products.washcare: Dry Clean for the first three washes
products.modelNote: Draped on a 5'7" model.

products.title: Champa Sequin Saree
products.subtitle: Hand-sequinned georgette
products.description: Matte sequins applied by hand across georgette in a graduated density, heaviest at the pallu. Weighted to hold the drape. Includes a stitched blouse to size.
products.productCare: Store flat in the bag provided. Sequins will catch on open weaves.
products.modelNote: Draped on a 5'9" model.

products.title: Ivy Pintuck Blouse
products.subtitle: Pintucked cotton poplin
products.description: A fitted blouse with vertical pintucks across the front panel and a covered back zip. Cut high at the neck and short at the sleeve.
products.productCare: Press pintucks from the reverse.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'8" and wears a size Small.

products.title: Zari Corset Blouse
products.subtitle: Zari-worked silk
products.description: A structured corset blouse with hand-worked zari across boned panels. Fully lined and finished with a hook-and-eye back closure.
products.productCare: Do not fold across the boning. Hang or lay flat.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'7" and wears a size Medium.

products.title: Noor Mirrorwork Lehenga
products.subtitle: Hand-set mirrorwork
products.description: A full lehenga with mirrorwork set by hand across the ghera, with a matched blouse and dupatta. Roughly three hundred hours of work across the set. Made to order.
products.productCare: Store in the muslin bag provided. Do not hang by the waistband.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'9" and wears a size Small on top and Small below.

products.title: Sitara Tulle Lehenga
products.subtitle: Layered tulle
products.description: Seven layers of tulle over a silk underskirt, with a fitted embroidered blouse. Light to wear despite the volume. Made to order in six to eight weeks.
products.productCare: Steam the layers separately. Store hanging with space.
products.modelNote: Model is 5'10" and wears a size Medium on top and Small below.

products.title: Sahar Organza Dupatta
products.subtitle: Hand-rolled hem
products.description: A wide organza dupatta with a narrow hand-rolled hem and a fine scalloped edge. Two and a half metres.
products.productCare: Store rolled. Steam to release creases.

products.title: Bagh Embroidered Dupatta
products.subtitle: Hand-embroidered silk
products.description: Dense hand embroidery across a silk ground, worked border to border in the bagh tradition. Two and a half metres. Each piece takes a single artisan several weeks.
products.productCare: Fold along the embroidery, never across it.

products.title: Jhalak Beaded Potli
products.subtitle: Hand-beaded
products.description: A drawstring potli, beaded by hand over a silk shell and lined in cotton. Fits a phone, a card and very little else, which is the idea.
products.productCare: Store in the dust bag. Beading will catch on knitwear.

products.title: Roshni Enamel Earrings
products.subtitle: Hand-enamelled brass
products.description: Drop earrings in hand-enamelled brass with a gold finish. Light enough to wear through a long evening. Sold as a pair.
products.productCare: Keep away from perfume and water. Store separately.

products.title: Kiran Silk Scarf
products.subtitle: Hand-rolled silk twill
products.description: A square scarf in silk twill with a hand-rolled edge, printed in a soft archival motif. Ninety centimetres square.
products.productCare: Steam lightly. Do not press the rolled edge flat.

products.title: Mehr Embroidered Belt
products.subtitle: Hand-embroidered, leather-backed
products.description: A wide waist belt, hand-embroidered on a leather backing with an antiqued brass buckle. Worn over a saree, a dress or a jacket.
products.productCare: Roll rather than fold. Condition the leather once a year.
